name: Observe and resolve job market intelligence from one live posting

userStory.intent: observe one live public job posting and project it through the market-intelligence pipeline
userStory.outcome: inspect an evidence-backed intelligence profile for that posting, honestly marked wherever facts have not yet been extracted from its content

experience.promise: the analyst can inspect a market-intelligence profile derived from one live-observed public posting, with every not-yet-extracted fact explicitly absent rather than fabricated

observableConditions.statement: the profile's lineage traces to the live-observed posting's real source and content identity
capability demand and market signals are empty, not invented, when the posting's facts have not been extracted
the profile explicitly states when change over time is not established
